input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the checklist at or above the preferred level and is not swallowed by any disclaimer. 19.1 warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel and material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications, with no time limit on the services warranty (better than the 90-day preferred / 30-day fallback floor). 19.2 gives each Deliverable 90 days from the later of delivery or acceptance and warrants that Hosted Services (Services include hosted software per §1.8) will conform throughout the subscription term, equalling or exceeding the 12-month software position. 19.3 carries the compliance-with-Applicable-Law and no-malicious-code warranties, and 19.4 supplies re-performance/repair/replacement plus a refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and confirms no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so there is no "AS IS" problem. Minor points short of ideal wording, noted rather than redlined: the malicious-code warranty covers only code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and the refund arises only after Vendor fails to cure within a reasonable period.
